NavierStokes.FiveProfileMoments.exists_normalized_repair (P : NavierStokes.FiveProfileMoments.Patch)
  (b : ℝ) (hb : NavierStokes.FiveProfileMoments.GoodExponent b) :
  ∃ g ε C,
    0 < ε ∧
      0 < C ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) g (Metric.ball 0 ε) ∧
          g 0 = 0 ∧
            ∀ d ∈ Metric.ball 0 ε,
              NavierStokes.FiveProfileMoments.normalizedMap P b (g d) = d ∧
                ‖g d‖ ≤ C * ‖d‖ ∧

rating.why: The most readable chapter: a quantitative inverse-function statement (a smooth local right inverse `g` of the normalised moment map near 0, with `‖g d‖ ≤ C‖d‖`, bounded derivative and a positivity side condition).
